features.weekday_mean_4w: mean non-empty sale_amount on the same weekday over lags 7, 14, 21, 28; fallback to the 28-day non-empty mean, then 0 when the shelf has no non-empty day in 28 days
features.trend_7v7: mean non-empty sales lags 1-7 divided by lags 8-14, clipped to [0.5, 2.0], missing becomes 1.0
features.empty_days_7: count of empty_flag yes over lags 1-7
features.empty_days_14: count of empty_flag yes over lags 1-14
features.empty_days_28: count of empty_flag yes over lags 1-28
features.days_since_empty: smallest lag in 1-28 whose empty_flag is yes; 28 when none
features.empty_same_weekday_1: 1 when empty_flag was yes on the same weekday one week before the target day, else 0
features.empty_same_weekday_2: 1 when empty_flag was yes on the same weekday two weeks before the target day, else 0
features.discount: decision-day discount rate, 1.0 means no discount

target: empty_flag == yes on the next day
target_unknown: target is null when the next day's flag is unknown
correction: on empty days the estimate is the largest of observed sales, weekday level times trend, and observed / max(fill share, 0.2)
demand_estimate: past-only same-weekday non-empty mean over 4 weeks (fallback 28-day non-empty mean, then 0) times trend clipped to [0.5, 2.0]
